description: This file defines a React component 'ProductDetailsPage' that fetches and displays product details based on an ID parameter. It imports functions and types related to API access, product data, and utilities, and incorporates a child component for adding the product to the cart.

methods.name: ProductDetailsPage
methods.description: An asynchronous React function component that fetches product info by ID and renders product details including name, brand/category, price, description, and an add-to-cart component.
